title: Esophageal and Gastric Diseases With Robotically Controlled Magnetic Capsule Endoscopy
brief_summary: Magnetically controlled capsule endoscopy (MCCE) is an outstanding opportunity for the painless endoscopic screening of the esophagus and stomach before small bowel examiantion. Further improvement in patients positioning might increase the esophageal transit time of the capsule endoscope and could improve the sensitivity and specificity of the esophageal MCCE investigation. Our present study aimed to compare the visualization of the esophagus (especially the Z-line) with different capsule swallowing protocols.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- patients referred for small bowel capsule endoscopy in any indication

Exclusion Criteria:

* known or suspected stricture in the GI tract
* previous surgery with bowel anastomosis
* swallowing complaints
* dementia
* implanted cardioverter defibrillator
* inability to sign the informed consent
study_population: Every patient who met the eligibility criteria and had MCCE examination with esophageal protocol.
